title: Chapter 63 — Multi-Threading and Institutionalizing
intro: Accounts that survive departures — threading both sides.

sections.title: Build Beyond One Contact
sections.content:
If your entire account relationship depends on one person at the builder's office and one person at your store — both are single points of failure.

Multi-thread the relationship. Connect your team to their team at multiple levels. When one person leaves, the relationship survives.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating multi-threading, ask:

Does the account relationship depend on one person — or multiple connections?
Is the relationship institutional — or personal?
Would the account survive a key departure on either side?
